items.label: 1929年
items.title: 物理学家盖尔曼出生
items.text: 盖尔曼生于纽约，把纷乱的基本粒子按性质归类，并提出它们由更小的夸克组成；预言中的新粒子后来在加速器里被找到，他因此获得1969年诺贝尔物理学奖。

sources.date_quote: Born: 15 September 1929, New York, NY, USA
sources.fact_quote: He proposed that observed particles are in fact composite, that is, comprised of smaller building blocks called quarks

items.label: 1932年
items.title: 化学家巴特利特出生
items.text: 巴特利特生于英国纽卡斯尔，在不列颠哥伦比亚大学把六氟化铂与氙混合，得到橙色的六氟合铂酸氙，改写了惰性气体不能成键的教科书结论。

sources.authority_type: university archive (University of California In Memoriam)
sources.date_quote: Bartlett was born on September 15, 1932, in Newcastle-upon-Tyne, England.
sources.fact_quote: He and his students had discovered that platinum hexafluoride, PtF 6 , was such a powerful oxidizing agent that it could even remove an electron from molecular oxygen

items.label: 1937年
items.title: 经济学家卢卡斯出生
items.text: 卢卡斯生于美国华盛顿州亚基马，把理性预期引入宏观经济学，认为人们会跟着政策规则调整判断，使政策效果随之改变，1995年因此获得诺贝尔经济学奖。

sources.fact_quote: Robert E. Lucas Jr is known as a very influential macroeconomist

items.label: 1951年
items.title: 苏联第六次双犬亚轨道飞行
items.text: 苏联实施第六次双犬亚轨道飞行，一只试验狗中途逃跑，工作人员在食堂附近找到替身小狗并取名ZIB，两只狗升到约一百公里高空后安全回收。

sources.date_quote: On September 15, 1951, the sixth of the two-dog launches occurred.
sources.fact_quote: One of the two dogs, Bobik, escaped and a replacement was found near the local canteen

items.label: 1968年
items.title: 探测器5号带生物绕月
items.text: 苏联探测器5号升空，舱内搭载乌龟、酒蝇、粉虫、植物种子与细菌等生物，几天后绕过月球背面，返回舱再入地球大气，为载人绕月试飞探路。

sources.date_quote: The first successful Zond (“probe”) launch was on September 15, 1968, when Zond 5 was launched.
sources.fact_quote: A biological payload of turtles, wine flies, mealworms, plants, seeds, bacteria, and other living matter was included in the flight

items.label: 1976年
items.title: 联盟22号升空测绘地球
items.text: 苏联把为联合飞行准备的备份联盟飞船改作对地观测平台，拆掉对接机构，换上东德蔡司耶拿研制的六通道多光谱相机，在较高纬度轨道上拍摄八天。

sources.date_quote: a solo Earth observation mission, launched on Sep. 15, 1976
sources.fact_quote: The MKF-6 camera, carrying six cameras tuned to different wavelengths in the visible and near-infrared parts of the spectrum, was a precursor to similar equipment carried aboard the Salyut-6

items.label: 1989年
items.title: 生物卫星9号搭载猕猴
items.text: 苏联生物卫星9号升空，两只猕猴在轨飞行两周，用于观察长时间失重对生物的影响；舱内蚂蚁和蚯蚓实验因温度异常而失败。

sources.date_quote: Bion 9/Kosmos 2044 was launched September 15, 1989, and carried the monkeys Zhakonya and Zabiyaka (“Troublemaker”) on a 14-day flight.
sources.fact_quote: Temperature problems onboard resulted in the loss of ant and earthworm experiments

items.label: 2017年
items.title: 卡西尼号坠入土星大气
items.text: 卡西尼号环绕土星十三年、燃料将尽，按计划冲入土星大气烧毁，以免日后撞上可能孕育生命的卫星；最后一段信号传回地球时，它已消失八十多分钟。

sources.date_quote: Cassini conducted science from orbit around Saturn until plunging into the giant planet's atmosphere on 15 September 2017.
sources.fact_quote: the Cassini orbiter produced a string of remarkable discoveries about Saturn's magnificent rings, its amazing moons and its dynamic magnetosphere
